verification.method: scripts/verify/edu-115.py reads the original World Bank zips (data/raw/wdi/), not the site's generated data; check-wdi.mjs compares all generated WDI values with the original files; then the text was read by hand
verification.what: every ranking row (119 countries and areas: order, value and year of each country's latest figure from 2015), the CSV, every figure in the text, FAQ, title, description and JSON-LD; claims: world 87.7% in 2024 and 65.4% in 1975 with slower gains since 2000, Chad lowest then Niger, Mali and Afghanistan, eight countries below 50% all in sub-Saharan Africa except Afghanistan, 16 at 99% or more, Bangladesh 79.0% (2022) from 29.2% (1981), only 20 of 86 high-income economies report; definition and caveats from the indicator notes
verification.against: World Bank WDI bulk files and indicator metadata (update 11 November 2026, CC BY 4.0; data from the UNESCO Institute for Statistics)
verification.result: Before publishing, single-year ranking was rejected (no year has more than 56 countries) in favour of each country's latest figure from 2015, shown with its year; the rankings hub note was updated to say so. All automated comparisons matched

changelog.note: First version: UNESCO adult literacy rates via World Bank WDI, latest year from 2015.
